declared: Declared on synthetic development data BEFORE any study-data run. The values below are fixed; a run reports against them and never adjusts them. The criteria of the existing Batch B ordinal verification (log-likelihood 1e-6, coefficient 1e-4, SE 1e-4) are not loosened or replaced: they remain in force for the legacy table and are reported for the refined table as well.

protocol.function: MASS::polr (method = logistic, Hess = TRUE) - unchanged specification: outcome ordered(integration_score, 1:4) with empty categories dropped, M2-L covariates, identical complete-case participants, logistic link, Wald z inference, odds ratio per SD of the exposure, BH over the 80 p-values
protocol.predictor_scaling: every non-intercept column of the model matrix (exposure, covariates, locality dummies) is centred on its complete-case mean and divided by its complete-case SD before fitting; coefficients, thresholds and the covariance matrix are transformed back exactly (beta = gamma / s; zeta = zeta_s + sum(beta * mu); V = T V_s T')

optim_control.ndeps_note: step of the finite-difference Hessian that polr reports (default 1e-3)

restarts.rule: restart polr from its own solution while the Newton decrement exceeds restart_if_newton_decrement_above

acceptance_criteria.note: A model is ACCEPTED only if every criterion holds. The optimiser convergence code is necessary but never sufficient.
acceptance_criteria.newton_decrement_note: sqrt(g' (-H)^-1 g) at the returned solution, analytic derivatives, affine invariant; BFGS with reltol 1e-14 cannot go below about 1.5e-7 because the objective is evaluated to double precision

statuses.LEGACY_REPRODUCTION: the legacy polr table recomputed in this run equals the Batch B frozen reference (strict validator, existing cumulative tolerance) and, if a legacy run folder is supplied, equals that run's ordinal_integration.csv (coefficient, SE, p, q80, n exactly)
statuses.LEGACY_NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION: informational: how many legacy polr fits are at the maximum (existing Batch B rule); never part of pass/fail
statuses.REFINED_NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION: PASS only if all 80 refined models are ACCEPTED; FAIL otherwise; never NOT_TESTED-as-PASS
statuses.REFINED_VS_LEGACY: descriptive comparison of the refined and the legacy table; not a pass/fail status
